title: Saint Paul Building Permits
description: Building permits issued by the City of Saint Paul: address, permit number, type, sub-type, work type, description, estimated value, contractor name and address, status and dates. Filter by date, type, value or contractor.
why: Saint Paul publishes each permit with the contractor on it, so this is both a project feed and a contractor activity feed.
useCases: Suppliers and subcontractors finding active projects and the GC running them

issuedSince.title: Issued on or after (YYYY-MM-DD)
issuedSince.description: Only permits issued on or after this date.

permitType.title: Permit type contains
permitType.description: e.g. Building, Plumbing, Mechanical, Electrical, Demolition

minValue.title: Minimum estimated value (USD)
minValue.description: Only permits at or above this value.

limits: Saint Paul refreshes this layer on its own schedule; at 2026-11-03 the newest record was dated 2025-06-30. Results sort newest first.
